grouping_policy.independence: No independence count inferred from 19 group keys, 15 complete source sets, proposed components or number of questions/prefixes.

scientific_implication: The three ready histories currently offer plan-change, scope and embedded-correction parsing; they do not yet establish ambiguous identity, cross-document correction-triggered support withdrawal, or a need for joint decoding. Treat absent coupling as a measured negative, never fabricate hypotheses to force it.
distribution_limit: Full responses and extracted texts remain outside checkpoint under capture distribution policy.
